The contract also permits early acceptance at its configured high-support threshold, so no hard seven-day execution delay is claimed.

controls.evidence: Pinned reads at Rootstock block 9077990 resolve the former apparent cycle: Governor 0x3b8853... is owned by VotingMachine 0x65a568..., while VotingMachine names that Governor as its controlled governor. The verified VotingMachine source executes an accepted proposal by calling controlledGovernor.executeChange; current registry reads report round 23 and the documented stake, quorum, acceptance, veto, and voting-period parameters.

review.evidence: Pinned Rootstock block 9077990 reads enumerate both and only direct USDRIF minters (RIF MocCore 0xA27024... and DOC bucket 0x697535...), the UUPS implementation, and the token's Governor; both LayerZero administration endpoints resolve to a 3-of-4 Rootstock multisig and a 2-of-4 Arbitrum Safe. Follow-up at Rootstock block 9114517 (2026-07-27): the recursive upgrade chain terminates in governance. ProxyAdmin 0x1a1824f39d79937dcb80c9d9938ae77e431c2def (EIP-1967 admin of both the Governor 0x3b8853... and VotingMachine 0x65a568... proxies) has owner() = 0x131564703310a294c1bfdc09d10ec0659f18e253, a transparent proxy whose own admin is the same ProxyAdmin and whose implementation is the Blockscout-verified Money on Chain UpgradeDelegator 0x6d1cca35aa431f2af0f0f2b9050c582b823ac731. In that verified source, upgrade(), upgradeAndCall(), and changeProxyAdmin() are all gated by onlyAuthorizedChanger(), which requires governor.isAuthorizedChanger(msg.sender); the UpgradeDelegator's governor() returns Governor 0x3b8853..., whose owner() is VotingMachine 0x65a568.... The Governor and VotingMachine proxy-upgrade path is therefore constrained by the same MOC token voting as the ordinary changer flow — upgrades execute only through MOC-vote-accepted changer contracts, with no enumerated keyholder bypass. M-2 evidence binding 2026-08-08: reconciliation continuous is structural - pinned Rootstock reads (blocks 9077990 and 9114517) prove the only USDRIF minters are the MoC protocol contracts (RIF MocCore and the DOC bucket), which mint exclusively against on-chain collateral under the sourced RIF On Chain V3 deployment; supply cannot exceed protocol-accounted collateral by construction.
